messages.text: Identify five potential research gaps based on this paper. For each gap, explain what the paper establishes, what remains unresolved, and what evidence supports the gap. Label your own deductions as inferences.

result.answer: Impact of specific mutation types (substitutions, insertions, deletions, and rearrangements) rather than a single generalized mutated state: The paper establishes that all damaging changes are grouped into one mutated state, leaving unresolved how specific types of mutations uniquely affect the payload, index, or adjacent fragments.
result.detailedAnswer:
Actual substitutions, insertions, deletions, and rearrangements can affect a payload differently, and treating every changed fragment as unusable can be pessimistic while assuming perfect error detection can be optimistic.

The model deliberately reduces a complex biological system to a small set of states, limiting the conclusions to comparing assumptions within the model.

Translating generations into elapsed time would require a specified growth and storage regime, and analytical extrapolations such as u ≈ 2 × 10-10 are not simulated observations or guarantees of complete-file recovery.
